notes.subject: בחזקה
notes.rationale: Hibru 'wantaim strong/olgeta strong' — mi raitim 'stret wantaim olgeta strong' bilong tokim pasin bilong singaut.

notes.subject: החמס
notes.rationale: khemas em i 'pasin bilong bagarapim narapela man, ol rong' — 'ol pasin bagarapim' i holim piksa bilong en.

notes.subject: בכפיהם
notes.rationale: 'long ol han bilong ol' — som man i tanim olsem 'olgeta ol i wokim', tasol piksa bilong kaf (palma bilong han) i stap.

notes.subject: long manmeri bilong Nainive
notes.rationale: Dekri i tok stret long ol manmeri na ol animal bilong Nainive, i givim ol komandmen.

translation: Na man na ol animal bilong lukautim ol i ken tikwelem ol sak, na ol i ken singaut stret wantaim olgeta strong long Elohim; na wanwan man i mas tanim bek long rot nogut bilong en, na long ol pasin bagarapim ol i holim long ol han bilong ol.

tokens.gloss: na ol i mas tanim bek
holim long ol han bilong ol
